# NCM checkpoints

Released tokenizer and generator pairs for Next-Concept Modeling. Each folder holds a `config.yaml` with the architecture and sampling settings and the `.pt` checkpoints it names.

- Paper: [Next-Concept Modeling](https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.14162)
- Project page: [Hazy Research blog](https://hazyresearch.stanford.edu/blog/2026-10-12-ncm)
- Code: [GitHub](https://github.com/HazyResearch/ncm)

| folder | task |
|---|---|
| `xsum/` | XSum summarization |
| `wmt14/` | WMT14 German-English translation |
| `sudoku/` | Sudoku, easy / medium / hard |
| `lm1b/` | One Billion Word, small / medium / large with a shared tokenizer |
| `tinystories/` | TinyStories |
| `owt/` | OpenWebText |

# NCM datasets

Evaluation sets for the released NCM checkpoints.

- **Paper**: [Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation](https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.14162)
- **Project page**: [Hazy Research blog post](https://hazyresearch.stanford.edu/blog/2026-10-12-ncm)
- **Code**: [GitHub repository](https://github.com/HazyResearch/ncm)

| folder | files | contents |
|---|---|---|
| `xsum/` | `passages.pickle`, `reference_summaries.pickle` | the complete XSum test set as tokenized article rows with summary slots, and the untruncated reference summaries as strings |
| `wmt14/` | `sources.pickle`, `reference_translations.pickle` | the WMT newstest German sources and English references as strings |
| `sudoku/{easy,medium,hard}/` | `puzzles.pickle`, `solutions.pickle` | held-out boards per difficulty: puzzle prefixes and completed grids as token lists |
| `lm1b/` | `train_bert_30522.bin`, `valid_bert_30522.bin` and their `_offsets.npy` files | One Billion Word training and validation token streams with sequence offsets |
| `tinystories/` | `train_bpe_8192.bin`, `train_bpe_8192.pickle`, `valid_bpe_8192.bin`, `valid_bpe_8192.pickle`, offsets and the BPE vocabulary and merges | TinyStories training and validation token streams under the custom BPE tokenizer |
| `owt/` | `train_gpt2.bin`, `valid_gpt2.bin` and their `_offsets.npy` files | OpenWebText training and validation token streams with document offsets |
